pairs.why: Near-identical cameras, but B's flash reflector has busier radial ribbing and its table shows more grain, while A's glow and wood are softer, like the smoother real cards.
A's warmer flash glow and smoother leather and wood are slightly nearer the soft, clean finish of the real cards; B's reflector and table are a little more detailed.
A's lighting is softer and its table less grainy; B's darker, sharper wood and reflector lean slightly toward the over-textured side.
A has the warm, glowing flash and smooth surfaces of the real cards; B's flatter light and visible table grain read a little more textured.
B's flash dish shows more fine radial texture, while A stays smoother and warmer, matching how clean the real cards are.
The two cameras are almost the same in shape, finish and light, so neither one is clearly closer to the real cards.
B's reflector has extra ribbed detail and its wood is crisper, while A's softer glow and smoother wood are nearer the real cards' finish.
Almost identical; A's slightly warmer glow and softer table grain just edge out B's crisper wood texture.
